chunks.text: Synthetic primary paper: the incidents-to-pull-requests ratio rose 242.7%. The instrument calibration remained unchanged.

Late qualification under an unmatched Erratum heading: this is an incidents-to-pull-requests ratio, not the probability of an incident. A pull request may link to multiple incidents. This observational comparison covers 40 adults and does not establish causation or applicability to children. Calibration is unaffected.
